source: H100 generated frames from CI failure artifact; regression baseline for corrected TeaCache semantics

validation.h100: One CI output; its reported comparison metrics were independently reproduced from artifact images. No repeated H100 request experiment.
validation.h200: Same-GPU main-parent/PR A/B: no-cache outputs bit-identical; PR target frames and final latent bit-identical across repeats, changed-shape history, cache toggles and simulated no-cache warmup. PR three-frame mean PSNR versus no-cache improved from 25.39 to 28.25 dB for this single prompt.
validation.scope: Only this H100 TeaCache regression baseline. Thresholds and official GT unchanged. H200 validation images are not used as GT. Isolated revision until the TeaCache fix is merged.
